title: GOLDEN HOUR — Solstice Hotel
recoveryNotes: The public deployment exposes index.html and dist/game.js only; unbundled source files and source maps are not supplied.
Removed only the 40960-byte Claude frame runtime injection from the HTML. Both recovered files match the published size and SHA-256.
The editable game script is the published JavaScript formatted without changing game logic or its bundled Three.js engine.
Both original style blocks are extracted in order to src/styles.css. The inline loader is replaced by the local Vite entry. No external runtime assets were found.
